_comment: Regions for scripts/compare-aetherrx.py, one entry per page, in our window's coordinates:
rectangles [x, y, width, height] or lists of [x, y] points. 'offset' is where our window's
(0, 0) falls in the reference screenshot, which has desktop round the window. A region's
'shift' is added to that for what sits elsewhere in our window: the rail, whose rows are
32 px lower for the Radio row above AetherNR. 'masks' leave out what AetherRX does not
have; those marked text only with --mask-text. Measured on 1.png (726x751, holding a
720x750 window whose last rows are cut off) against offscreen renders at 720x750.
